title: The Gilded Spire Anew
author: Xanthe Ravensworth
blurb: Coral Winterbourne, a cartographer of unmapped realms, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
